page.content:
Nick Cartone is a character in Cars 2. He is a blue Honda Civic reporting the World Grand Prix. He is one of the many reporter cars who ask Lightning McQueen how he lost the race in Tokyo.

page.overview:
Who is Nick Cartone?

Nick Cartone is a character in Cars 2. He is a blue Honda Civic reporting the World Grand Prix. He is one of the many reporter cars who ask Lightning McQueen how he lost the race in Tokyo.
